result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but a likely missing profile icon and several abruptly clipped horizontal carousel items make the right edge look unfinished.

issues.description: The circular account control in the upper-right appears empty, showing only a gray placeholder and a small red notification dot with no profile/avatar icon.
issues.suggestion: Render the intended avatar or a clear default profile icon, while keeping the notification badge positioned on its edge.

issues.description: A category pill is cut off at the far-right edge, with none of its label visible. This resembles an accidental empty shape rather than a useful horizontal-scroll cue.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel spacing or initial scroll position so part of the next label is visible, or hide the next pill cleanly until the user scrolls.

issues.description: The third card in “Fastest near you” is abruptly clipped, including its restaurant name and delivery text at the viewport edge.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearer carousel treatment with consistent side padding, snapping, or a fade/overflow mask so partially visible cards and text look intentional.
